description: Advised by Dr. Hongzhi Guo. Research funded by the NASA Nebraska Space Grant and the Layman Seed Award. Developing an end-to-end live holographic video streaming testbed over private OpenAirInterface (OAI) 5G standalone networks with offline RL adaptive streaming, and novel cross-modal semantic mulsemedia communication models.

Authored industry-sponsor pitch for migrating holographic communication systems from HoloLens 2 to Meta Quest 3 with AI-based quality enhancement; mentor 5-member undergraduate engineering teams on point cloud capture, transmission, and system integration.

Built and deployed Kathmandu University's venue booking system (MERN stack) on a self-managed Ubuntu VM used by all KU departments and students (hallbooking.ku.edu.np). Developed the AICKU employee logsheet management system used by 300+ staff (logsheet.aic.ku.edu.np) and the Nepal Technology Innovation Center website (ntic.ku.edu.np). Delivered digital literacy programs across 8 remote schools in partnership with local municipalities.

Containerized and deployed international point-of-sale (POS) microservices using Docker and Kubernetes across AWS and Azure. Developed Python ETL pipelines for Snowflake/SQL data warehousing, built Power BI reports, and deployed an EFK stack (Elasticsearch, Fluentd, Kibana) for centralized cluster log monitoring.

Designed, developed, and deployed production websites with SEO optimization for the 9th IPSF APRO Good Pharmacy Practice Education (GPPed) program and the Kathmandu University Architecture Club (archclub.ku.edu.np).
